consequence.statement: CiliumNetworkPolicies with multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules, previously ignored, are now rejected by the apiserver.
consequence.remediation: Fix or remove such invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies before applying them.

original.statement: Invalid CiliumNetworkPolicies (multiple L7 protocols on the same port, over 40 port rules, or over 40 ICMP rules) that were previously ignored are now rejected by the apiserver via server-side validation.

decision.reason: [ev-abfbf30753a5] says that CiliumNetworkPolicies with multiple L7 protocols on the same port, more than 40 port rules or more than 40 ICMP rules were always ignored before, and now get server-side validation and "will now be rejected by the apiserver". That makes resource-rejected the right kind, and mandatory work is the right class. The proposed statement repeats the evidence's own wording without claiming more. The remediation (fix or remove these policies) follows directly from that rejection.
